registration_subject: season desk 941fe39f: corpus loader, statistics, ratings model, pre-registered strategies

staking_assumption.vig: one cent each way; a -110/-110 market is used for every ROI
staking_assumption.clv_definition: close minus our devigged fair price, in probability points, signed in favour of the side we took

strategies.name: Model side, any disagreement
strategies.rule: Bet the side the model favours whenever sign(model_margin) != sign(market_spread) and |residual| >= 0.5 points. No filter. Price: the two-sided spread price in the corpus, de-vigged.

G1_SAMPLE.why: the sample size at which a 55% edge is separable from 52.4% break-even at 80% power (luck_panel.py power calculation)

G2_PRICE.rule: every graded bet carries a two-sided price at the same clock time
G2_PRICE.why: no price means no ROI; a one-sided price cannot be de-vigged (F-01 in the prior desk)

G3_CLV.rule: beat the close: requires an opening price AND a closing price from the same book, so that CLV = (taken price - closing price) can be signed
G3_CLV.why: CLV is the least noisy skill measure, but it cannot be computed from a single snapshot. Measuring 'model minus closing line' instead would be circular: it is the selection rule itself

G3B_ALPHA.rule: out-of-sample residual alpha: corr(model_margin - market_spread, result - market_spread) > 0 with a 95% interval excluding 0 on the holdout
G3B_ALPHA.why: this is the only skill statement a one-snapshot corpus can support: does our disagreement with the close contain information about the result relative to the close

G4_BSS.rule: Brier skill score vs the de-vigged closing market > 0 on the holdout
G4_BSS.why: the market is the benchmark that matters; beating a coin flip is not skill

G5_CALIBRATION.rule: calibration slope in [0.8, 1.25] and intercept |a| < 0.05 on the holdout
G5_CALIBRATION.why: a model that is right on average but wrong in the tails is not usable for staking

G6_MULTIPLICITY.rule: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 across every strategy tested in this family set
G6_MULTIPLICITY.why: testing 12 rules at alpha 0.05 finds one 'winner' 46% of the time by chance alone

G7_SURVIVAL.rule: Brier skill on the validation window has the same sign as on the holdout
G7_SURVIVAL.why: a rule that flips sign out of sample is noise

G8_DECAY.rule: no single season contributes more than 40% of a strategy's total profit
G8_DECAY.why: one lucky season is not a strategy

strategies.name: Model side, disagreement >= 2 points
strategies.rule: Same as S01 but only when |model_margin - market_spread| >= 2.0 points. Tests whether a bigger disagreement is a better signal or simply a bigger model error.

strategies.name: 2-leg parlay, model sides, independent games
strategies.rule: Two legs from DIFFERENT games in the SAME week, each qualifying under S02, combined at the joint price only if a joint price exists in the corpus. The corpus carries no joint price, so the combination is priced from the product of the marginal de-vigged probabilities at the standard -110 parlay price. Registered as a JOINT-EVIDENCE TEST, not as a bet.

G7_SURVIVAL.rule: Brier skill on the validation window has the same sign as on the holdout
G7_SURVIVAL.why: a rule that flips sign out of sample is noise

G8_DECAY.rule: no single season contributes more than 40% of a strategy's total profit
G8_DECAY.why: one lucky season is not a strategy

strategies.name: Control: always home
strategies.rule: Bet the home side on every game at the closing spread.

G1_SAMPLE.why: the sample size at which a 55% edge is separable from 52.4% break-even at 80% power (luck_panel.py power calculation)

G2_PRICE.rule: every graded bet carries a two-sided price at the same clock time
G2_PRICE.why: no price means no ROI; a one-sided price cannot be de-vigged (F-01 in the prior desk)

G3_CLV.rule: beat the close: requires an opening price AND a closing price from the same book, so that CLV = (taken price - closing price) can be signed
G3_CLV.why: CLV is the least noisy skill measure, but it cannot be computed from a single snapshot. Measuring 'model minus closing line' instead would be circular: it is the selection rule itself

G3B_ALPHA.rule: out-of-sample residual alpha: corr(model_margin - market_spread, result - market_spread) > 0 with a 95% interval excluding 0 on the holdout
G3B_ALPHA.why: this is the only skill statement a one-snapshot corpus can support: does our disagreement with the close contain information about the result relative to the close

G4_BSS.rule: Brier skill score vs the de-vigged closing market > 0 on the holdout
G4_BSS.why: the market is the benchmark that matters; beating a coin flip is not skill

G5_CALIBRATION.rule: calibration slope in [0.8, 1.25] and intercept |a| < 0.05 on the holdout
G5_CALIBRATION.why: a model that is right on average but wrong in the tails is not usable for staking

amendment_policy: A rule may not be edited after registration. A change is a new strategy with a new id and a fresh window, and the superseded id stays on the leaderboard marked retired. The site reads this file and publishes the commit it was registered against.
